THE SCENE

You are on your school's engineering team, in the school garden. A fog net on the hill fills the garden's water tank. But the tank is always close to empty. Before anyone builds a new net, you must write down the problem. You need four facts. Four people each know one.

THE HISTORY

This mystery is about fog nets in Chile. Fog is a cloud that touches the ground. In 1992, fog nets gave water to Chungungo, a desert town. Each square meter of net caught about three liters a day.
